title: Casual Monster Slayer
description: Casual monster slayer is deadpan heroism in ordinary clothes: supermarket wardrobe, impossible creature work, the same naturalistic light on both. The joke is register clash, and the camera should look like coverage of a commute, not a poster.

sections.title: Narrative function

blocks.text: Keep the tote bag. Make the dragon expensive.
A person in a hoodie or an undershirt does creature work as if it were a chore, then wants to get home. Handheld or a simple lock-off.
If the camera goes baroque, the gag dies and you have a grimdark poster with a hoodie. It is the wrong tool when the hero is already designed as a warrior, or when you wanted a win pose.
Mighty fighter is that posed cousin. This one still has dirty sneakers.

sections.title: How it works

blocks.text: Eye height, 35mm, handheld or lock-off. Describe the mundane outfit in boring detail, then put the creature or weapon in the same key: available street, kitchen practical, overcast.
Same grade on both. No rim that turns them into a sprite.
Prompt: Casual monster-slayer of [Subject], everyday clothes, impossible creature work, deadpan heroism, a commute that includes a dragon.

sections.title: Questions

blocks.text: What is Casual Monster Slayer in film?
A register-clash recipe: everyday clothes, impossible creature work, deadpan coverage. The camera looks like a commute. The threat does not.
Casual Monster Slayer vs Mighty Fighter
Mighty fighter is a posed champion, low three-quarter, hard rim. Casual monster slayer is the same joke with a tote bag and ordinary light. If they look like a sprite, you wandered.
When should I use Casual Monster Slayer?
Comedy-horror and deadpan heroism. Skip grimdark posters and any beat that needs a select-screen stance.
How do I prompt Casual Monster Slayer for AI image or video?

Name the boring outfit, the creature, eye-height handheld or lock-off, then: Casual monster-slayer of [Subject], everyday clothes, impossible creature work, deadpan heroism, a commute that includes a dragon.
